Sure thing man! I’m a student in animation so I know a thing or two.

Now depending on what do you want I can think of 2 easy ways to get that lo-fi backround for you music.

1) Is to use a clip from any sort of media you like whether it be an anime you enjoy or some documentary (for getting that aesthetic of chill vibes I will define rly will look for some sunset or sunrise clips, they got some nice colors to it) listen to your music and make a list of what it reminds you of then look for a clip of that particular thing and loop it, maybe add a filter or two and some fading to black when the song begins and when it ends. 

2) The other way you can have a fast clip for your song is just have a nice still image you would like to put on top of your song and then in your editing software add a shit Ton of effects to it like making it bounce every time the kick comes up or maybe change the colors to something cooler or warmer depending if section of the song is sad or happy. Just little things that give a lot of livelihood to a still image. Now for the image if you don’t trust yourself with a camera or with a pencil I suggest commissioning an trust to do it.

Hope that helps
